sourceChecks.note: Laco's exact active product route identifies Augsburg 39 article 861988 and its brown calf-leather strap with rivets. It publishes EUR 390, available status with two-to-three-day delivery, 39 x 11.55 x 46.5 mm geometry, 18 mm lugs, 81.5 g including the strap, LACO 2S based on Miyota 82S0, 50 m resistance, sapphire front and caseback crystals, and Super-LumiNova C3 on hands and dial. C3 identifies material, not repeatable performance. Retrieved 2026-08-30.
Laco's current FAQ maps LACO 2S to Miyota 82S0 and states that every installed LACO 2S is regulated by its watchmakers to 0/+25 seconds per day with a 42-hour power reserve. Retrieved 2026-08-30.

Miyota's current 82S0 technical page publishes its base -20/+40 seconds-per-day specification, 42-hour reserve, automatic and hand-winding operation, stop seconds, three-hand open-heart display, and no calendar function. The exact Laco product and FAQ identify this as the base caliber, while Laco's tighter installed-watch regulation controls the reviewed accuracy values. Retrieved 2026-08-30.

Laco's currently retrievable leather-watch-strap instructions return a valid manufacturer PDF. The English instructions require a spring-bar tool for preparation and require the strap and spring bars to be properly installed. Combined with the exact product page's identification of the configured strap as Laco calf leather, this supports spring-bar case attachment; the visible rivets remain decorative strap construction. Retrieved and text-validated 2026-08-30.

The first provider result attributed attachment and time-only statements to this purported LACO 2S manual, but direct retrieval returns HTTP 404. None of its extracted statements are admitted. Attachment is instead supported by Laco's live leather-strap manual, and time-only status by Miyota's live 82S0 specification. Checked 2026-08-30.
